title: HeteGCD: Statistics-Aware Dual-Prototype Learning for Generalized Category Discovery on Heterophilous Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.36696v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Heterophilous graphs are prevalent in real-world applications, where connected nodes often exhibit dissimilar attributes or belong to different classes, posing significant challenges to conventional graph learning methods based on homophily. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced in generalized category discovery (GCD), which requires models to recognize known classes and discover novel ones using labels from known classes only. However, existing graph GCD methods typically rely on aforementioned homophily-based inductive biases, which are ill-suited to heterophilous graphs. Meanwhile, although current heterophilous graph learning methods exploit diverse neighborhood signals, their selection and fusion are often guided by supervision across all classes, including novel classes whose labels are unavailable in GCD. translated_title: HeteGCD：面向异质图上广义类别发现的统计感知双原型学习
translated_abstract: 异质图在现实应用中广泛存在，其中相连的节点往往表现出不同的属性或属于不同的类别，这给基于同质性的传统图学习方法带来了重大挑战。这一局限性在广义类别发现（GCD）任务中尤为突出，GCD要求模型仅利用已知类别的标签来识别已知类别并发现新类别。然而，现有的图GCD方法通常依赖上述基于同质性的归纳偏置，这并不适用于异质图。与此同时，尽管当前的异质图学习方法利用了多样的邻域信号，但其选择与融合往往依赖于涵盖所有类别的监督信息，其中包括在GCD中无法获得标签的新类别。这些局限性引出了一个关键问题：如何有效利用异构邻域信息……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出HeteGCD方法，通过统计感知的双原型学习，在异质图上有效利用异构邻域信息实现广义类别发现，从而在仅有已知类别标签的条件下同时识别已知类别并发现新类别。
en_tdlr: HeteGCD introduces statistics-aware dual-prototype learning to effectively leverage heterogeneous neighborhood information for generalized category discovery on heterophilous graphs, enabling recognition of known classes and discovery of novel classes using only known-class labels.
